info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Knowledge Asset Intellectual Property Portfolios-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access a comprehensive list of intellectual property portfolios associated with knowledge assets in the banking domain. By leveraging this endpoint, businesses can efficiently retrieve detailed information about various portfolios, including their attributes and relevance. Typical consumers include product managers, legal teams, and financial analysts seeking insights to optimize asset management strategies. The endpoint facilitates informed decision-making and ensures that stakeholders have up-to-date access to intellectual property data.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the complete portfolio of intellectual property assets, providing details and insights into each asset available for review and management.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve information regarding the intellectual property portfolio, including patents, trademarks, copyrights, and associated metadata. The request body allows for filtering and specifying the details required in the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the intellectual property portfolio.

ListKnowledgeAssetIntellectualPropertyPo.description: A string representation of the request body for retrieving the intellectual property portfolio.
